info.title: Klinik Takip API
info.description: Doctor–patient follow-up platform. Every endpoint requires a bearer token unless documented otherwise; permissions are checked per route and patient access is scoped per role.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in, sessions, two-factor enrolment and invitations

tags.name: patients
tags.description: Patient files, search and staff assignment

tags.name: me
tags.description: What a patient — or their consented caregiver — sees about themselves

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Append-only access trail and anomaly detection

totpCode.description: Six-digit TOTP code, when 2FA is enabled

deviceName.description: Shown in the session list, e.g. "iPhone 15"

status.description: OK carries tokens. MFA_REQUIRED means resend the request with totpCode. MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED means the account is staff and has no second factor yet; use setupToken against the 2FA endpoints, then sign in again.

setupToken.description: Only with MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED. Valid for five minutes and accepted only by /auth/2fa/setup and /auth/2fa/confirm.

message.description: Human-readable text, or a machine-readable code for authentication failures (INVALID_CREDENTIALS, MFA_REQUIRED, ACCOUNT_LOCKED, …).

refreshToken.description: Single-use. Presenting a consumed token revokes the whole device session.

familyId.description: Session family id; pass to DELETE /auth/sessions/{familyId}

current.description: True for the device making this request

secret.description: Base32 secret, shown once so it can be entered by hand

uri.description: otpauth:// URI to render as a QR code

patientId.description: Links the new account to an existing patient file

code.description: Returned exactly once, for delivery by SMS or e-mail. Only its hash is stored.

identifier.description: The e-mail or phone the invitation was sent to

before.description: State before the change. Null for reads. Credentials are redacted.

after.description: State after the change. Credentials are redacted.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, drives language and discharge advice

version.description: Send this back as expectedVersion when editing. A mismatch means someone else changed the record and the write is refused (spec M15).

deletedAt.description: Set when the file is deactivated. Records are retained by law, not destroyed.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

expectedVersion.description: Version the client read; a mismatch is refused
Version the client read; a mismatch is refused

medicationsDueToday.description: Doses scheduled for today that are still waiting

missingDocuments.description: Mandatory pre-op documents not yet uploaded (spec M17)

secondaryValue.description: Diastolic; only blood pressure uses it

unit.description: Defaults to the unit the type is stored in

measuredAt.description: Defaults to now; set it when entering an older reading

source.description: Device readings are kept distinguishable from entered ones (spec M20)

weightKg.description: The weight this point was computed from

heightCm.description: The height in effect when that weight was taken

targetWeightKg.description: Null when no goal has been set

targetBmi.description: The same goal on the BMI axis

secondaryValue.description: Diastolic; only blood pressure uses it

unit.description: Defaults to the unit the type is stored in

measuredAt.description: Defaults to now; set it when entering an older reading

receivedBytes.description: The offset to send next — resume from here

checksum.description: SHA-256 the client computed over the file it read. Checked against the assembled bytes, so a corrupted transfer is refused rather than filed.

mime.description: Detected from the bytes, not from what was declared

jobId.description: The processing job queued for this upload

mime.description: Detected from the bytes, not from what was declared

error.description: Safe to show staff; never file contents

analyteCode.description: LOINC, where it could be mapped

flag.description: Null when there is no range

needsAttention.description: The engine was unsure; look at this one first

awaitingMapping.description: The printed name has no code yet

refLow.description: The range this result was measured against

unit.description: Series are split by unit; the same analyte in two units is two series

reference.description: Null when the points were measured against different ranges

analyteCode.description: LOINC code; supplying it teaches the mapping

phaseLabel.description: Free text: milestones differ per procedure (pre-op, post-op D1, W2, M1…)

exifStripped.description: Location metadata was removed before storing

consentId.description: Photo-usage consent; without one the photo is clinical-use only

photos.description: Oldest first: a progression reads forwards

note.description: What is wrong, in the patient's own words

photoIds.description: Photos already uploaded for this patient

waitingMinutes.description: Minutes from report to first answer, or to now while waiting

overdue.description: Still unanswered past the clinic threshold

message.description: What the clinician told the patient

open.description: Whether the clinic is reachable now

senderId.description: Null for clinic or system messages

transcript.description: Set once the AI layer transcribes audio (Faz 5)

queuedUntil.description: When a held message will be delivered

triageLevel.description: What the clinic acted on: the higher of the keyword screen and the AI reading

triageFlags.description: Ids of the red flags that fired, never the phrases they matched

aiTriageLevel.description: The AI's own reading. Advisory: it can raise triageLevel, never lower it

aiSummary.description: Three lines for the clinician (complaint / measurements / duration). Shown beside the message, never instead of it

nextCursor.description: Pass back to load older messages

mediaKey.description: Key returned by the attachment upload

queuedUntil.description: Set when the message was held until the clinic opens

mime.description: Detected from the bytes, not from what was declared

staffId.description: Null for a reply the whole clinic shares

deviceId.description: So a reinstall replaces its own token, not another

failureReason.description: Why this attempt did not arrive

fallbackForId.description: The attempt this one is standing in for

label.description: D1, W1, M1, M2, M3, M6, Y1 — matches the photo phase labels

remindersSent.description: Reminders already sent — P7D, P1D, PT2H

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude; dropped if implausible, never refused

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude; dropped if implausible, never refused

note.description: What is happening, in the patient's words

escalationLevel.description: Highest rung of the ladder taken: 0 now, 1 at 2 min, 2 at 5 min

countryCode.description: Country the number was chosen for

critical.description: The one line that points away from the clinic

alreadyOpen.description: The button was pressed again on a call already open

unanswered.description: The ladder ran out and it is still unanswered

falseAlarm.description: Closes it as a false alarm rather than a real one

enabled.description: False when no provider is configured

spentUsd.description: USD spent since the start of the month

budgetUsd.description: Null when no cap is set

budgetUsedFraction.description: 0–1, null when no cap is set

failed.description: Calls that failed or were refused

patientFacingMd.description: Plain-language rendering. Only returned to the patient once released

disclaimer.description: The warning that goes under every AI output (spec M5), in the patient's language

release.description: Whether the patient may see the plain-language half

disclaimer.description: The warning that goes under every AI output (spec M5)

content.description: The document text. Chunked on the way in

procedureType.description: Restricts retrieval to patients who had this procedure; omit for general advice

chunks.description: How many pieces the document was split into

embedded.description: False when no embedding provider was configured

questionMessageId.description: The stored question — the handle for "this answer is not enough"

answer.description: Null when a person is answering instead

sources.description: Clinic documents the answer came from

handoverReason.description: Why the question went to a person
